subject: Stormline onboarding: ops checklist & SLO exchange
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@stormline.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stormline onboarding: ops checklist & SLO exchange

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the Stormline connector. To speed up launch and reduce break-glass calls later, I attached a short ops checklist and an initial SLO draft. Key items we want to align on before the integration goes live:

- Incident severity definitions and expected acknowledgement windows (P1/P2/P3)
- On-call contacts and escalation matrix (PagerDuty integration details)
- Expected availability target for the managed connector and measurement cadence
- Log/telemetry retention and how Stormline will request access to audit logs
- Runbook ownership for cross-system failures (Stormline vs Redwood)

Proposal summary in the attached SLO draft: P1 acknowledgement within 30 minutes, P2 within 4 hours, target availability 99.95% for the connector. If any of those are blockers for you, call them out and we can compromise (e.g., 99.9% for the first quarter).

Can you send the PagerDuty integration key and primary on-call contact? I suggest a 60-minute joint runbook pairing session next week to walk through a simulated failover and validate alert routing.

Attachments: ops-checklist.xlsx (stub), stormline_slo_draft.pdf (stub)

Thanks,

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partner Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Elena Park <elena@stormline.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Smith <msmith@stormline.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stormline onboarding: ops checklist & SLO exchange

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the checklist — this is helpful. I attached our SLO draft as well (we already have internal commitments around customer-facing SLAs). A few notes after a quick pass:

- Availability: Our commercial SLA is currently 99.9% for connectors. We can discuss 99.95% but need an internal approval cycle first.
- Escalation: Our on-call rotation is primary: Michael Smith (msmith@stormline.ai), secondary: Tanya Ruiz (tr@stormline.ai). We use PagerDuty; I'll pull the integration key and share it.
- Audits: We require audit-log export every 24 hours for the first 90 days after launch. Can Redwood provide automated daily exports?
- Runbook: happy to do a runbook workshop — Tue/Thu next week work for us.

Attaching stormline_slo_draft.pdf for reference. I'll try to get the PagerDuty info to you by EOD.

Best,

Elena Park
Head of Partnerships | Stormline AI
elena@stormline.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stormline onboarding: ops checklist & SLO exchange

Looping in a couple quick operational notes before we respond formally to Elena: 

- Availability target: I'm fine with a pragmatic ramp to 99.9% for Q1 with a committed roadmap to 99.95% by the following quarter. Call this an onboarding SLA tier.
- Audit logs: Redwood Console can emit daily exports to an S3 bucket; we'll need Stormline's bucket ARN and a retention window. We should make a short runbook step to automate the daily export and a monitoring check to verify delivery.
- PagerDuty: For PD integration we prefer a service integration key (not a user). We should provide a short template for their PD mapping (severity -> PD priority).
- DocuSign: Legal will want an SLA addendum. Can Soojin request the DocuSign flow once we settle the numbers?

I'll draft the suggested compromises and the PD mapping template and drop into the runbook doc linked below.

Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PLAT/pages/Stormline+Runbook

— Jonas
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena@stormline.ai>

- Runbook workshop: Tue Nov 16 at 10:00 AM PT works. Please send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Elena

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Elena. Summary / action items from our side before the workshop:

2) Jonas to add PD mapping template to the runbook.
